Visiting speaker from | From the Information Office 
849 - 5331 Ext. 57 


Lima, Peru, Feb. 19 & 20. 


HARRY THOMAS 


For Immediate Release 


Roy G. Smith, YMCA World Service Fraternal Secretary frem Lima, Peru 
will speak to audiences at the Montreal Metropolitan YMCA on February 
19th and 20th. 

From 1952 to the present time Mr Smith has seen the YMCA in Lima, Peru 
grow from one branch and two playground eentres with a membership of 
2,000 and with three staff, to seven branches, seven playground centres, 
two permanent camp sites, a membership pf 12,000 and sixteen staff. 

He has travelled widely in Peru and all Central and South American 
countries. 

Mr Smith previous to his Peru assignment worked in the Philippines 
assisting the development of the YMCA in that country fohlowing the 
shambles of World War II. 

Mr Smith is a native of the United States and currently is making a 


speaking tour of North America on behalf of YMCA World Service.
